description: Optional highlighting controls for a SearchQuery. When present (or when the boolean 'highlight' flag is true) each hit's field list includes HTML-tagged snippets showing where the query matched. These options refine the default highlighter: which columns to highlight, snippet sizing, and the surrounding tags.

fields.description: Column names to highlight. Empty or null highlights every text-bearing column. Non-text columns named here are ignored.

fragmentSize.description: The maximum number of characters in each highlighted snippet. Maps to the OpenSearch 'fragment_size'. Defaults to the OpenSearch default (100) when omitted.

numberOfFragments.description: The maximum number of snippets to return per field. Maps to the OpenSearch 'number_of_fragments'. Defaults to the OpenSearch default (5) when omitted.

preTag.description: The opening tag inserted before each matched term. Maps to the OpenSearch 'pre_tags'. Defaults to '<em>' when omitted.

postTag.description: The closing tag inserted after each matched term. Maps to the OpenSearch 'post_tags'. Defaults to '' when omitted.
